description: Answer questions about how Fabrica works from Fabrica's own published documents: docs.fabrica.land, the help center and the US trust agreement. Returns the best matching passages with their URLs, so an answer can be cited. Covers the trust structure, fees, Property checks, lending, property taxes, the onramp and offramp, the legal framework, the glossary and the MCP server itself. When the question names a specific property, wallet or listing, the result also suggests which lookup tool to call. Retrieval is lexical over a committed index, with no external call.

maxPassages.description: How many passages to return (1-10, default 5)

question.description: The question in plain language, e.g. 'Who is the trustee of the trust that holds my property?'

source.description: Restrict to one source: 'docs', 'help' (help center), 'trust-agreement', or 'all' (default)

name: ask_fabrica
title: Ask Fabrica
